displayIdentity.body: Paul reasons among Athenian altars. Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was provoked within him as he saw the city full of idols. But certain men joined with him and believed, including Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.
